10467-a-select-collection-of-old-english.title: of all the Commentators, and new Notes
10467-a-select-collection-of-old-english.creator: W. Carew Hazlitt
10467-a-select-collection-of-old-english.description: A book by W. Carew Hazlitt. kind to the one to wean him before his time_, and too fond upon the other to keep him so long without preferment: the one is ancient and of much reading; the other is young, but full of wit.

3019-pointed-roofs.title: Pointed Roofs
3019-pointed-roofs.creator: Dorothy M. Richardson
3019-pointed-roofs.description: A book by Dorothy M. Richardson. the other books, little and great, and challenging comparison with them. I am no longer prejudiced by the guise in which it comes; I have been able, within my limits, to judge it as I would judge any other novel....

arxiv-2012-02802.title: SLITronomy : towards a fully wavelet-based strong lensing inversion technique
arxiv-2012-02802.creator: A. Galan, A. Peel, R. Joseph, F. Courbin, J.-L. Starck
arxiv-2012-02802.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by A. Galan, A. Peel, R. Joseph, F. Courbin, J.-L. Starck. Strong gravitational lensing provides a wealth of astrophysical information on the baryonic and dark matter content of galaxies. It also serves as a valuable cosmological probe by allowing us to measure the Hubble constant independently of other methods. These applications all require the difficult task of inverting the lens equation and simultaneously reconstructing the mass profile of the lens along with the original light profile of the unlensed source.

arxiv-2101-00122.title: Generative Max-Mahalanobis Classifiers for Image Classification, Generation and More
arxiv-2101-00122.creator: Xiulong Yang, Hui Ye, Yang Ye, Xiang Li & Shihao Ji✉
arxiv-2101-00122.description: Abstract Joint Energy-based Model (JEM) of [ 11 ] shows that a standard softmax classifier can be reinterpreted as an energy-based model (EBM) for the joint distribution p ⁡ ( 𝒙 , y ) p(\bm{x},y) ; the resulting model can be optimized to improve calibration, robustness and out-of-distribution detection, while generating samples rivaling the quality of recent GAN-based approaches.

arxiv-2207-05036.title: New constraint on neutrino magnetic moment and neutrino millicharge from LUX-ZEPLIN dark matter search results
arxiv-2207-05036.creator: M. Atzori Corona, W. M. Bonivento, M. Cadeddu, N. Cargioli, F. Dordei
arxiv-2207-05036.description: Abstract Elastic neutrino-electron scattering represents a powerful tool to investigate key neutrino properties. In view of the recent results released by the LUX-ZEPLIN collaboration, we provide a first determination of the limits achievable on the neutrino magnetic moment and neutrino millicharge, whose effect becomes non-negligible in some beyond the Standard Model theories.

arxiv-2309-15931.title: The outer dusty edge of accretion disks in active galactic nuclei
arxiv-2309-15931.creator: Hermine Landt 1,∗
arxiv-2309-15931.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hermine Landt 1,∗. Recent models for the inner structure of active galactic nuclei (AGN) aim at connecting the outer region of the accretion disk with the broad-line region and dusty torus through a radiatively accelerated, dusty outflow. Such an outflow not only requires the outer disk to be dusty and so predicts disk sizes beyond the self-gravity limit but requires the presence of nuclear dust with favourable properties.

arxiv-2312-10378.title: The Dijkgraaf-Witten invariants from second Chern classes
arxiv-2312-10378.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Given a 3-cocycle ψ \psi in the cohomology of a finite group G G , we can define the Dijkgraaf-Witten invariant of closed 3-manifolds. In this paper, we focus on the case where ψ \psi is a 3-cocycle systematically transferred from the second Chern class of a complex representation of G G , and show some procedures for computing the invariant, and clarify its topological interpretation under some conditions.

arxiv-2403-13378.title: IIDM: Image-to-Image Diffusion Model for Semantic Image Synthesis
arxiv-2403-13378.creator: Feng Liu, Xiaobin Chang
arxiv-2403-13378.description: Abstract Semantic image synthesis aims to generate high-quality images given semantic conditions, i.e. segmentation masks and style reference images. Existing methods widely adopt generative adversarial networks (GANs). GANs take all conditional inputs and directly synthesize images in a single forward step.

arxiv-2410-23885.title: Nested Symmetric Polar Codes Thanks: This work is supported by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) within the project Open6GHub (grant no. 16KISK019).
arxiv-2410-23885.creator: Marvin Rübenacke, Andreas Zunker, Felix Krieg, and Stephan ten Brink
arxiv-2410-23885.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a data-driven algorithm to design rate- and length-flexible polar codes. While the algorithm is very general, a particularly appealing use case is the design of codes for AED ( AED ), a promising decoding algorithm for URLLC ( URLLC ) and mMTC ( mMTC ) applications.

arxiv-2502-02589.title: COCONut-PanCap: Joint Panoptic Segmentation and Grounded Captions for Fine-Grained Understanding and Generation
arxiv-2502-02589.creator: Xueqing Deng, Qihang Yu, Ali Athar, Chenglin Yang, Linjie Yang, Xiaojie Jin, Xiaohui Shen, Liang-Chieh Chen
arxiv-2502-02589.description: Abstract This paper introduces the COCONut-PanCap dataset, created to enhance panoptic segmentation and grounded image captioning. Building upon the COCO dataset with advanced COCONut panoptic masks, this dataset aims to overcome limitations in existing image-text datasets that often lack detailed, scene-comprehensive descriptions.

arxiv-2504-09201.title: Macroscopic fluctuation theory of correlations in hard rod gas
arxiv-2504-09201.creator: Anupam Kundu
arxiv-2504-09201.description: Abstract Recently, a theoretical framework known as ballistic macroscopic fluctuation theory has been developed to study large-scale fluctuations and correlations in many-body systems exhibiting ballistic transport. In this paper, we review this theory in the context of a one-dimensional gas of hard rods.

arxiv-2505-07075.title: Coherence of velocity fluctuations in a turbulent round jet
arxiv-2505-07075.creator: T. Singla, M. Caelen, F. Pétrélis, S. Fauve
arxiv-2505-07075.description: Abstract Coherence between the velocity fluctuations measured at two points is investigated in a turbulent jet flow. Coherence is calculated in different regions of the flow by changing the separation between the points, the distance between the points from the exit of the jet and from its central axis, and the injection velocity of the jet.

arxiv-2508-20161.title: Positive Geometry for Stringy Scalar Amplitudes
arxiv-2508-20161.creator: Christoph Bartsch, Karol Kampf, David Podivín, Jonah Stalknecht
arxiv-2508-20161.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Christoph Bartsch, Karol Kampf, David Podivín, Jonah Stalknecht. We introduce a new positive geometry, the associahedral grid, which provides a geometric realization of the inverse string theory KLT kernel. It captures the full α ′ \alpha^{\prime} -dependence of stringified amplitudes for bi-adjoint scalar ϕ 3 \phi^{3} theory, pions in the NLSM, and their mixed ϕ \phi / π \pi amplitudes, reducing to the corresponding field theory amplitudes in the α ′ → 0 \alpha^{\prime}\to 0 limit.

arxiv-2510-05310.title: RAG Makes Guardrails Unsafe? Investigating Robustness of Guardrails under RAG-style Contexts
arxiv-2510-05310.creator: Yining She, Daniel W. Peterson, Marianne Menglin Liu, Vikas Upadhyay, Mohammad Hossein Chaghazardi, Eunsuk Kang, Dan Roth
arxiv-2510-05310.description: Abstract With the increasing adoption of large language models (LLMs), ensuring the safety of LLM systems has become a pressing concern. External LLM-based guardrail models have emerged as a popular solution to screen unsafe inputs and outputs, but they are themselves fine-tuned or prompt-engineered LLMs that are vulnerable to data distribution shifts.

arxiv-2602-03563.title: ACL: A ligned C ontrastive L earning Improves BERT and Multi-exit BERT Fine-tuning Thanks: Corresponding author. For any inquiries, please contact: michaelwzhu91@gmail.com. Affiliation: DataSelect AI, Xuhui, Shanghai, China
arxiv-2602-03563.description: Abstract Despite its success in self-supervised learning, contrastive learning is less studied in the supervised setting. In this work, we first use a set of pilot experiments to show that in the supervised setting, the cross-entropy loss objective (CE) and the contrastive learning objective often conflict with each other, thus hindering the applications of CL in supervised settings.

plos-pone-0004016.title: Wind, Waves, and Wing Loading: Morphological Specialization May Limit Range Expansion of Endangered Albatrosses
plos-pone-0004016.creator: Robert M. Suryan, David J. Anderson, Scott A. Shaffer et al.
plos-pone-0004016.description: PLOS ONE research article. Among the varied adaptations for avian flight, the morphological traits allowing large-bodied albatrosses to capitalize on wind and wave energy for efficient long-distance flight are unparalleled. Consequently, the biogeographic distribution of most albatrosses is limited to the

pmc-11513771.title: Synergistic effects of fibrin-enriched adipose decellularized extracellular matrix (AdECM) and microfluidic model on vascularization†
pmc-11513771.creator: Yu-Yin Shih, Chun-Wei Kao, Yi-Rong Jhong, Yi-An Chen, Yi-Wen Chen
pmc-11513771.description: Vasculature is essential for maintaining the cellular function and balance of organs and tumors. As a key component of the tumor microenvironment (TME), it significantly influences tumor characteristics. Angiogenesis, heavily influenced by the extracellular matrix (ECM), which acts as a structural scaffold and growth factor reservoir, is regulated by various factors.

pmc-11539069.title: Mitigation Strategies against Antibody Aggregation Induced by Oleic Acid in Liquid Formulations
pmc-11539069.creator: Dominik Zürcher, Klaus Wuchner, Paolo Arosio
pmc-11539069.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Polysorbates 20 and 80 (PS20 and PS80) are commonly used in the formulations of biologics to protect against interfacial stresses. However, these surfactants can degrade over time, releasing free fatty acids, which assemble into solid particles or liquid droplets. Here, we apply a droplet microfluidic platform to analyze the interactions between antibodies and oleic acid, the primary free fatty acid resulting from the hydrolysis of PS80.

pmc-11614964.title: The effect of pre-operative exercise training on post-operative cognitive function: a systematic review
pmc-11614964.creator: Hatice S Ekici, Jemima Collins, Aysegul H Kafadar, Mehmet C Yildirim, Bethan E Phillips, Adam L Gordon
pmc-11614964.description: Key summary pointsAimTo investigate the effect of pre-operative exercise training on post-operative cognition.FindingsThere are very few studies examining the effect of pre-operative exercise training on post-operative cognition. However, based on the results of previous studies, pre-operative exercise may increase post-operative cognition. More studies are needed to demonstrate the effect of pre-operative exercise training more clearly on post-operative cognition.

pmc-12563696.title: Dental Pulp Stem Cell-Derived Organoids: Advancing the Development of 3D Structures
pmc-12563696.creator: Loreto Lancia, Fanny Pulcini, Emanuela Mari, Luca Piccoli, Leda Assunta Biordi, Luciano Mutti, Claudio Festuccia, Giovanni Luca Gravina, Vincenzo Mattei, Annunziata Mauro, Valentina Notarstefano, Simona Delle Monache, Joni H Ylostalo
pmc-12563696.description: Highlights What are the main findings? The main aim of this article is to propose a validated and standardized protocol for characterising and conducting advanced structural analyses of dental pulp-like organoids using Raman microspectroscopy. What is the implication of the main findings?

pmc-12636659.title: Data-driven cluster analysis identifies three clinical phenotypes in hemodialysis patients
pmc-12636659.creator: Canyu Chen, Yifei Lu, Junxiang Qiu, Honglin Xiong, Liang Zhou, Tao Wu
pmc-12636659.description: Clinical heterogeneity among hemodialysis patients necessitates precision medicine approaches transcending conventional single-parameter management. Through machine learning analysis of 1,207 maintenance hemodialysis patients, we developed a novel two-tier phenotyping framework integrating unsupervised K-means clustering across 22 clinical indicators with supervised classification using six universally available biomarkers.

pmc-13030614.title: Diagnostic Test Accuracy and Semi-Quantitative Metrics of 18F-FDG PET in Assessing Treatment Response in Skull Base Osteomyelitis and Necrotising Otitis Externa: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13030614.creator: Mark Laidlaw, Maya Reid, Sukanya Rajiv, Jean-Marc Gerard
pmc-13030614.description: Simple SummarySkull base osteomyelitis is a severe bone infection near the ear requiring prolonged antibiotic treatment. Clinicians face difficulty determining when to safely stop antibiotics, as stopping too early risks dangerous relapse, while continuing too long causes medication side effects. Traditional imaging cannot distinguish healing bone from active infection.

pmc-13237297.title: CB1 receptor signaling at the cingulate-striatal circuit is anxiogenic
pmc-13237297.creator: Thomas J. Kelly, Xiaojie Liu, Yao Huang, Ying Hu, Vladislav Friedman, Cecilia J. Hillard, Qing-song Liu
pmc-13237297.description: Cannabinoids, such as Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), produce anxiety at high doses, yet the underlying neural mechanisms remain poorly understood. The anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) sends dense monosynaptic projections to the dorsomedial striatum (DMS). Optogenetic excitation of the ACC → DMS pathway promotes anxiolytic-like behavior, suggesting that its suppression could induce anxiogenic states.

pmc-13328085.title: Multimodal graph neural network with large language models for node and link prediction
pmc-13328085.creator: Bo Peng, Huan Xu, Xiangjiu Che

pmc-13483704.title: Kidney health among adolescents living in a high-risk region for CKDu
pmc-13483704.creator: Selene Vences Brown, Yirong Yuan, Samantha M. Hall, Juan José Amador Velázquez, Damaris López Pilarte, Magaly Rosario Amador Amador Sánchez, Juan José Amador Sánchez, Josefa Elena Moya González, Alfonso Cesar Boza Gaitan, Stephanie Gonzalez Gil, Madeleine K. Scammell, David J. Friedman, Daniel R. Br
pmc-13483704.description: BackgroundAn epidemic of chronic kidney disease of uncertain origin (CKDu) imposes devastating mortality and morbidity in Central America, where the disease is termed Mesoamerican Nephropathy (MeN). MeN typically presents in young men working in heat-intensive manual jobs, notably agriculture, although the full disease etiology is unclear.

pmc-13588463.title: Primary Localized Cutaneous Amyloidosis: A Histological and Immunohistochemical Appraisal
pmc-13588463.creator: Nithye Parvathy, Rashmi Joshi, Rajsmita Bhattacharjee, Uma N. Saikia, Dipankar De, Debajyoti Chatterjee

pmc-13668468.title: Application of machine learning techniques to automate speech mispronunciation detection in children and adolescents
pmc-13668468.creator: Nazila Ameli, Mahshid Nik Ravesh, Luan Matheus Trindade Dalmazo, Karen Pollock, Daniel DeSantis, Manuel Lagravere, Hollis Lai
pmc-13668468.description: Introduction Speech sound disorders (SSDs) are common in children and can affect academic and psychosocial outcomes. Clinical identification relies on expert auditory-perceptual assessment, which is time-intensive and may vary across raters. Automated screening tools could support triage when access to specialists is limited.
